title: A Face for Denim Days
caption:
A Face for Denim Days

I have worked in makeup for twenty years.
My first job was at a luxury beauty counter in Japan.

Heavy makeup was the trend then.
As a beauty advisor, I wore full makeup every day —
three shades of foundation,
black as a base under eyeshadow.
Smoky, full coverage, always making a statement.

A little embarrassing to admit,
but I wore that same face on my days off, in denim.
A perfect face with casual, effortless clothes.
With the right balance, that can look luxurious.
With my skills back then, it did not.

Change your makeup with your outfit.
This is one of the real keys to looking beautiful.
A jacket calls for jacket makeup.
Denim calls for denim makeup.

I hope you see makeup as part of your whole look.
So on a relaxed day off,
it is fine to do a little less.
